claim: Ideas about causality from philosophy can help scientists to better understand how cancerous tumors grow and spread in the body.
source: Here we argue that ideas about causality from philosophy can help scientists to better understand how cancerous tumors grow and spread in the body.
evidence: This is a stated argument in the abstract of the manuscript.

claim: Feedback loops and interactions between tumor-cell-intrinsic and tumor-cell-extrinsic factors are important for explaining the formation and dissemination of tumors.
source: After outlining six characteristics of causality that are relevant to cancer, we emphasize the importance of feedback loops and interactions between tumor-cell-intrinsic and tumor-cell-extrinsic factors for explaining the formation and dissemination of tumors.
evidence: This is a central thesis stated in the abstract and supported throughout the manuscript with multiple examples.

claim: In the somatic mutation theory, the default state of a cell is quiescence.
source: In the somatic mutation theory, which centers on the tumor cells, the default state of a cell is quiescence, and a tumor forms as a result of genetic mutations in a single cell (Stratton et al., 2009).
evidence: This is a description of the somatic mutation theory supported by citation to Stratton et al., 2009.

claim: In the somatic mutation theory, a tumor forms as a result of genetic mutations in a single cell.

evidence: This is a description of the somatic mutation theory supported by citation to Stratton et al., 2009.

claim: In the tissue organization field theory, the default state of the cell is proliferation.
source: In the tissue organization field theory (TOFT; right), the default state of the cell is proliferation, and a disruption of the tissue architecture leads to the diffusion of various mutations within the tumor and to the activation of the tumor microenvironment (TME).
evidence: This is stated in the text and shown in Figure 1.

claim: In the tissue organization field theory, disruption of tissue architecture leads to the diffusion of various mutations within the tumor and to the activation of the tumor microenvironment.
source: In the tissue organization field theory (TOFT; right), the default state of the cell is proliferation, and a disruption of the tissue architecture leads to the diffusion of various mutations within the tumor and to the activation of the tumor microenvironment (TME).

claim: The tissue organization field theory involves feedback mechanisms that lead to further disruption of tissue architecture, which promotes tumor expansion and dissemination.
source: In the tissue organization field theory (TOFT; right), the default state of the cell is proliferation, and a disruption of the tissue architecture leads to the diffusion of various mutations within the tumor and to the activation of the tumor microenvironment (TME). Through feedback mechanisms, this leads to further disruption of the tissue architecture, which promotes tumor expansion and dissemination.
evidence: This is stated in the text and illustrated in Figure 1 with feedback arrows.

source: Although these two theories have their strengths and weaknesses, we believe that recent work tends to support the tissue organization field theory more than the somatic mutation theory, at least for some cancers.
